description: Implementation of Protocol Buffers support in Go using unsafe pointers, including functions for accessing struct fields and manipulating pointers for serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: pointer
classes.description: A wrapper around unsafe.Pointer providing methods for accessing and manipulating various data types and slices in protobuf serialization.

methods.name: toPointer
methods.description: Converts a Message interface to a pointer struct.

methods.name: toAddrPointer
methods.description: Converts an interface to a pointer that points to the interface data, considering whether it's a pointer type.

methods.name: valToPointer
methods.description: Converts a reflect.Value of pointer type to a custom pointer struct.

methods.name: offset
methods.description: Returns a new pointer offset by a field's byte offset.

methods.name: isNil
methods.description: Checks if the pointer is nil.

methods.name: setInt32Ptr
methods.description: Sets a *int32 value at the pointer.

methods.name: getInt32Slice
methods.description: Loads a []int32 slice from the pointer.

methods.name: setInt32Slice
methods.description: Stores a []int32 slice into the pointer.

methods.name: appendInt32Slice
methods.description: Appends an int32 to the slice at the pointer.

methods.name: appendPointer
methods.description: Appends a *pointer to the slice at the pointer.

methods.name: getInterfacePointer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the interface data.

methods.name: asPointerTo
methods.description: Returns a reflect.Value that is a pointer to an object of type t at the pointer location.
